mapper.select: SELECT e.id FROM organization_employee e JOIN organization_department d ON d.id=e.department_id AND d.created_by=e.created_by WHERE e.department_id=#{departmentId} AND e.created_by=#{ownerId} AND e.status='ACTIVE' AND d.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY e.id

SELECT e.id,e.name,e.phone,e.department_id,d.name department_name FROM organization_employee e JOIN organization_department d ON d.id=e.department_id AND d.created_by=e.created_by WHERE e.id=#{employeeId} AND e.created_by=#{ownerId} AND e.status='ACTIVE' AND d.status='ACTIVE'

SELECT t.id FROM training t WHERE t.created_by=#{ownerId} AND t.requirement_type='REQUIRED' AND (t.audience_type='ALL' OR (t.audience_type='DEPARTMENT' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM training_scope_target s WHERE s.training_id=t.id AND s.target_id=#{departmentId}))) ORDER BY t.id

SELECT t.id,t.assessment_id FROM training t WHERE t.id=#{trainingId} AND t.created_by=#{ownerId} AND t.requirement_type='REQUIRED' AND (t.audience_type='ALL' OR (t.audience_type='DEPARTMENT' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM training_scope_target s WHERE s.training_id=t.id AND s.target_id=#{departmentId}))) FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_audience(training_id,employee_id,candidate_name,phone,department_id,department_name) SELECT #{trainingId},#{employeeId},#{candidateName},#{phone},#{departmentId},#{departmentName} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM training_audience WHERE training_id=#{existingTrainingId} AND employee_id=#{existingEmployeeId})
